about: Hand-curated venue research for the IAEM annual assembly, keyed by the code its forms-wizard adapter gives the venue, with the halls and the poster area the agenda names. Every figure is {value, source}, or null when nobody could cite it; coordinates carry the basis they rest on and their source.

avenue-airport-city.name: Avenue Conference & Events Center
avenue-airport-city.notes: At the entrance to Airport City, between Ben Gurion Airport and Kfar Truman; the entrance is at the building's south-western corner (the conference site).
